tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[a nonproper isometric action]

Source: petersen:page-0221 ↗ def:pet-ch5-proper-action 1. ch5:5.6.18$\operatorname {Iso}(M)$ acts properly on $M$ (Arzelà–Ascoli), but a subgroup $H\subset \operatorname {Iso}(M)$ need not act properly unless closed: the action $\theta \cdot (z_1,z_2)=(e^{i\theta }z_1,e^{i\alpha \theta }z_2)$ of $\mathbb R$ on $S^1\times S^1$ is proper iff $\alpha $ is rational. \end{example}
